key_findings: Substance P reduced occludin expression in hCMEC/D3 cells at low but not full confluence, via the truncated NK-1R.
SP stimulated Erk2 phosphorylation without changing IL-6, IL-8 or ICAM-1 and did not trigger calcium release.
